text: Code reviews are a valuable practice in software development, where team members examine each other’s code before it is merged into the main project. One major benefit is catching bugs early. A fresh pair of eyes can spot mistakes or logic errors that the original writer may have missed, saving time and effort later. Beyond that, code reviews promote knowledge sharing. Team members learn new techniques and become familiar with different parts of the codebase, which reduces dependency on a single person. Most importantly, they build team quality by encouraging clear communication and consistent standards, leading to stronger, more reliable software overall.
